decision: kept four reliability failures in one run but split them into independently checked units
why: each symptom has a separate boundary and test path
result: baseline green with 150 tests passed and 3 skipped

decision: reproduced submission identity loss and duplicate Home Assistant work with an offline runtime harness
why: the live database evidence needed a deterministic local mechanism check
result: reproduced stuck feed and URL rows plus two concurrent syntheses

decision: used one in-flight accept outcome per slug and attached every supplied submission id to it
why: one conversion owns extraction and synthesis while each submission owns its durable status
result: one extraction and synthesis per slug; all supplied rows succeeded

decision: measured the seeded library before changing its lifecycle
why: the browser had to prove that player construction caused the request burst
result: initial load made 6 audio and 3 progress reads; one sort added 5 audio, 3 progress reads, and 4 progress writes

decision: reduced speech chunks to 5000 characters and retried only timeout, 429, and 5xx failures
why: smaller ordered chunks remove the observed latency trigger while bounded retries handle transient failures
result: 36 tests passed; STT kept its 60000 ms deadline and TTS uses 120000 ms per attempt

decision: added module-owned deadlines to six outside fetch boundaries and caught recurring poll rejection
why: a finite request budget stops one upstream from holding a handler or later poll forever
result: 62 focused tests passed; startup still rejects and later poll failures are logged

decision: set library players to preload none and allowed progress writes only after restore and playback
why: the browser owns intent and can reject untouched restore or teardown writes that the server cannot distinguish
result: untouched load and sort made zero audio and progress requests; 19 focused player tests passed

decision: kept the final code after the full suite, browser walkthrough, and PR 20 merge-tree check
why: the real browser and the combined git tree cover behavior and adjacent-branch risk
result: 179 tests passed and 3 skipped; build passed; merge-tree had no conflicts; idle browser made no media or progress requests

decision: removed the client timeout from progress restore
why: a failed restore must not authorize a later write that can replace unseen server progress
result: 19 player tests and the build passed

decision: kept final submission-write failures as logged infrastructure errors
why: retrying or reconciling database outages needs a durable restart policy beyond the reproduced identity-loss fault
result: open risk: a database outage or process crash can still leave processing rows

decision: consolidated six repeated timeout fixtures into one helper
why: the first test draft repeated timing races instead of testing each boundary directly
result: one caller-visible timeout test per outside boundary

decision: reran the unrelated cloudHosts cleanup failure before the final suite
why: the ENOTEMPTY failure is intermittent and does not import changed modules
result: cloudHosts passed 7 tests; full suite then passed 179 with 3 skipped
